SuperDial Inc., the creator of voice-first artificial intelligence agents for automating healthcare workflows, is overhauling its platform with a new Agent-to-Agent RCM architecture. The goal is to eliminate the compute inefficiencies that have arisen as autonomous workers become more prevalent in the industry. The startup, which raised $15 million in a Series A funding round […]
